title: Abuurkii Dagaalka
intro: Kahor inta adduunku ogaan khilaaf baahsan, waxaa soo ifbaxay imtixaan qoto dheer oo iimaan iyo addeecid ah. Sheekadani waxay sahamisaa doorashooyinka uu sameeyay qof, oo falalkiisu ay tusaale u yihiin jiilalka soo socda. Isu diyaari inaad furto sheekada naf la halgamaysa hinaasaha aadka u weyn iyo cawaaqib xumadiisa.
clues: Waxaan ka mid ahaa farcankii ugu horreeyay ee dhulka ku socday, anigoo ah ilmo ay dhaleen lamaane aadame oo ugu horreeyay.
Aniga iyo walaalkay waxaa la faray inaan Alle u bixinno allabaryo, taasoo ah imtixaan lagu ogaanayo daacadnimadeenna.
Dalabkaygii lama aqbalin, halka kan walaalkay la aqbalay, taasoo qalbigayga ka buuxisay dareen xun.
Waxaan walaalkay kula hadlay erayo hanjabaad ah, iyadoo ay igu kaliftay qadhaadhka diidmada.
Walaalkay ayaa ku jawaabay xigmad iyo cibaado, isagoo i xasuusinaya caddaaladda Alle iyo cabsida uu ka qabo.
Inkastoo walaalkay hadallo dabacsan iyo rabitaankiisa ah inuu cafiyo, haddana waxaan iska dhigay qof aan waxba galabsan, anigoo noqday mid ka mid ah kuwa khasaaray.

outcome.label: Natiijo
options: Waxaa la siiyay hanti aad u badan

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
